name: Korashime 2 ~Kyouikuteki Depaga Shidou~
original_name: 懲らしめ2 ～狂育的デパガ指導～
source:
Main character is a deputy manager in a good store. One day female employee gets into an incident, and bad rumors start to spread around protagonist. As time passes, he learns the female employee that started those rumors and decides to have his revenge on her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家高级商店的副经理。一天，一名女员工卷入事件，关于主人公的坏传闻开始流传。随着时间过去，他得知正是那名女员工散播了谣言，于是决定向她复仇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
